title: Settlement Statement Notes: Splitting the Final Rental Invoice
content:
The final invoice of a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental is split between insurer, network and customer within the class's settlement period in business days of the return. The rental has been returned before its invoice is split.

## The split by coverage source

| Coverage source | Billed to the payer | Charged to the customer |
|---|---|---|
| Customer's own rental coverage (first party) | The covered days at the lesser of the partner rate and the daily cap, never more than the insurer's total rental limit in total | The daily-cap excess on each covered day, plus any covered-day cost above the total rental limit as uncovered days |
| Another driver's insurer (third-party liability) | The covered days at the partner rate of the class the insurer covers | |
| Warranty courtesy | The covered days, billed to the network | |

Class differences, young-renter fees, options, tolls, fuel and cleaning are always the customer's.

## First-party amounts defined

For a rental under the customer's own rental coverage:
- the covered-day cost is the lesser of the class partner rate and the insurer's daily cap;
- the insurer's portion is the lesser of the total rental limit and the covered days multiplied by the covered-day cost;
- the daily-cap excess is the covered days multiplied by the amount by which the partner rate exceeds the daily cap, or zero where it does not;
- the over-limit uncovered amount is the covered days multiplied by the covered-day cost, less the total rental limit, or zero where that is not positive.

## Worked split (hypothetical figures)

An Intermediate Rental at a partner rate of 46.99 USD, an insurer daily cap of 40.00 USD, a total rental limit of 300.00 USD and 8 covered days: the covered-day cost is 40.00 USD; 8 covered days at 40.00 USD come to 320.00 USD, so the insurer's portion is 300.00 USD and the over-limit uncovered amount is 20.00 USD; the daily-cap excess is 8 days at 6.99 USD, 55.92 USD.

## The rental must be returned

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Applies to | Booking the customer's charges and the bills to the insurer or network |
| Condition | The rental has been returned before its invoice is split |
| Evidence | The status of the reservation being settled |
| Authority | The system record, read before the split is booked |
| Status that meets it | Returned |

## Clauses no longer in force

- The clause under which every rental day not covered is an uncovered-days charge at the class partner rate is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.
- The clause under which a customer-pay rental is charged entirely as uncovered days, at the class weekly rate for each full seven-day block once it reaches the weekly-rate threshold days, is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.
- The clause under which such a rental carries a customer-pay discount credit of the class customer-pay discount percent when it is tied to a network repair is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.
